name: wikitext2-MIA-Benchmark-Concat
description: A dataset constructed from Wikitext-2 designed for benchmarking membership inference attacks against language models by concatenating contexts and targets to form membership/non-membership examples. It measures how well attack models can distinguish whether specific sequences were part of a target model's training data.
reputation: Niche dataset used in membership-inference and privacy research; modest adoption within the model auditing community.
